test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Cell phones **__keeps loved ones and those nearly__** them well connected.

options.text: keep loved ones and those near

solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"keep loved ones and those near."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence is with the subject-verb agreement.
 
• The subject **"cell phones"** is plural.
 
• So, we must use a plural verb with it.
 
• The plural form of the verb** "keep" **is **"keep."**
 
• The word** "near" **must be used instead of **"nearly."**
 
• In this context,** "near" **suggests a closeness in physical distance, emphasizing the idea that cell phones help maintain connections with people who are physically close or nearby.
 
• On the other hand, **"nearly"** would imply an approximation, which may not be the intended meaning in this sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

Correct sentence: *Cell phones **keep loved ones and those near**__ them well connected.*
